description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to parsing text and file paths within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It defines methods for reading text with delimiters, parsing file paths into components like drive, filename, extension, and path.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text with delimiter-based methods, including reading text segments.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing file paths into drive, filename, extension, and path components.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads a text segment up to a delimiter or quote, starting from a given offset.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text segment and stores it in an OptionalType<TextFragment> result.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a file path into drive, filename, extension, and path components.
